predecessor.reason: V7 independently proves the beacon is the unique preregistered future round rather than trusting receipt no-reroll flags.

public_beacon_rule.network: League of Entropy drand quicknet mainnet
public_beacon_rule.selection: Use exactly the first quicknet round at or after execution-freeze commit timestamp + delay_seconds.
public_beacon_rule.verification: Task, aggregate and submitter independently retrieve this exact freeze blob from the beacon-declared commit and recompute the unique round.

task_hash_rule: SHA256(canonical JSON of family, grammar, cell, prediction-freeze hash, science-freeze hash, execution-freeze hash)
receipt_rule: Every task writes a receipt. Mixed schemas, stale hashes, missing/duplicate tasks, wrong seed/round/randomness, nonzero exits, sub-million GREEN or missing null frontier invalidate the aggregate.
protected_execution: No K4 V7 protected task may execute until the V7 beacon receipt exists and independently verifies against this exact freeze commit.
claim_ceiling: Execution provenance closure only. Protected K4 evidence still pending; IG-4 meter bucketing, IG-5 primitive selection, K5, real transfer and physical frontier evidence remain separate.
